description: Build the missing experiment loop infrastructure that turns the n-autoresearch pattern into a first-class JARVIS capability: experiment logger, composite score, WFE computation, CLI runner, and search strategy advisor

userStories.title: Experiment Logger (experiment_log.py)
userStories.description: As JARVIS, I want a structured experiment log so each RL run is recorded with its config delta, metrics, composite score, and keep/reset decision — replacing the manual rl_config.py comments
acceptanceCriteria: engine/strategies/experiment_log.py created
ExperimentLog class with log_experiment(), get_best(), get_near_misses(), list_all()
Persists to JSONL file at engine/data/rl_experiments/experiment_log.jsonl
Each record has: run_id, timestamp, symbol, category, hypothesis, reward_config_delta, metrics (pf, wfe, sharpe, n_trades, pass_rate, recommendation), composite_score, kept (bool)
compute_experiment_score(wfe, pf, sharpe, n_trades) function that returns float
Near-miss detection: within 0.05 WFE or 0.20 PF of best
Typecheck passes (mypy --strict compatible types)
userStories.notes: JSONL = one JSON object per line, append-only. No DB dependency.

userStories.title: WFE computation in train_walkforward result
userStories.description: As JARVIS, I want actual Walk-Forward Efficiency (WFE = OOS_return / IS_return) computed and returned by train_walkforward so experiment scores are grounded in real efficiency, not just pass_rate
acceptanceCriteria: rl_trainer.py train_walkforward result dict includes 'wfe' key (float 0.0-1.0+)
WFE computed as: mean_oos_return / mean_is_return clamped to [0.0, 2.0]
Returns 0.0 if IS return is zero or negative (degenerate case)
Existing result dict fields unchanged (backward compatible)
Logged in trainer output: '[RLTrainer.WF] WFE=0.82'
userStories.notes: WFE formula: avg(OOS pf across windows) / avg(IS pf across windows). IS metrics come from training_summary in each window result.

userStories.title: Experiment CLI runner (run_experiment.py)
userStories.description: As JARVIS (or a 10-agent session), I want a CLI script that implements the full 11-step n-autoresearch loop for a single RL experiment — edit config, train, measure, score, compare, log, recommend keep/reset
acceptanceCriteria: engine/strategies/run_experiment.py created
CLI args: --symbol MCL --category reward_shape --hypothesis 'text' --config '{"hold_cost": -0.008}' --timesteps 100000 --windows 8
Calls train_walkforward with the reward_config override
Computes composite score via compute_experiment_score()
Compares against best experiment from ExperimentLog
Logs result to ExperimentLog
Prints clear summary: RUN N | CATEGORY | SCORE | vs BEST | KEEP/RESET
Exit code 0=keep, 1=reset (for shell scripting)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Does NOT auto-commit or auto-reset git. Prints recommendation only. git keep/reset is manual per n-autoresearch discipline.

userStories.title: Search strategy advisor (search_strategy.py)
userStories.description: As JARVIS, I want a search strategy function that reads the experiment log and recommends the next experiment category and mode (explore/exploit/combine/ablation)
acceptanceCriteria: engine/strategies/search_strategy.py created
suggest_next_experiment(symbol) returns: {mode, category, rationale, suggested_delta}
Explore mode: any category with < 3 experiments
Exploit mode: best-scoring category, suggest tighter delta around best config
Combine mode: two near-miss experiments from different categories
Ablation mode: triggered if no improvement in last 5 experiments
Printable summary for CLI use
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Lightweight — reads experiment_log.jsonl, no ML needed. Pure decision logic.
